prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Create a HIGH DETAIL LEFT-HALF production asset from the supplied transparent blue and ivory curtain. Do NOT include the right half. This image will be mirrored in CSS to form the complete curtains at double the effective resolution.
Output one landscape 1536 × 1024 transparent PNG. Magnify and faithfully reconstruct ONLY the LEFT HALF of the supplied artwork so it fills the ENTIRE width of the output, from the left outer corner at x=0 to the original centre join at x=1536. Eliminate the redundant transparent bottom half: the long pointed end of this existing SHORT left side drape should finish at y=1000, near the bottom of this output. Keep all fabric proportions as close as possible to the reference, adapting its original 768x584 occupied left-half bounding rectangle to this 1536x1024 canvas.
Composition: royal blue and warm ivory striped fabric enters at the left top edge, held by the antique gold circular rosette at the extreme top-left corner. One shallow swag dips across the entire upper part of the canvas and rises back to the TOP-RIGHT edge, which is the future centre seam. Gold fringe follows the swag curve. At the TOP-RIGHT endpoint a small gold acanthus leaf flourish, with fabric reaching the canvas edge. The single hanging left side drape occupies only the leftmost 12% of the output; its spiral striped fabric and intact pointed gold fringe tip finish near y=1000. This has ONE rosette, ONE left vertical drape, ONE upper swag. The rest of the canvas is completely empty true transparent alpha. No right-side rosette or right-side curtain, no frame, text, logo, badge, paper, background, or drop shadow.
Improve fine detail: precise engraved crosshatching, crisp gold fringe threads, clean stripe edges, elaborate rosette petals, and delicate historical woven textile marks. Match the supplied royal blue, warm ivory, antique gold and vintage lithographic character. Preserve the shape and shallow depth of the swag, the relatively narrow side drape, and the distinctive diagonal blue/ivory stripe rhythm. Keep top and left fabric flush to canvas edges.
